messages.subject: Few Questions regarding MaAslin Programming
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Thank you for taking the time to read this. I am curious about a couple other things underlying how MaAslin runs its analyses.

1) Does MaAslin use a generalized linear model or is it a linear model? ( I am concerned with outliers and non normalized data)

2). How is the boosting done in MaAslin? Would you be able to provide us with a reference paper of how this is done and what it means?

3). Is the adjustment (i.e. Bonferoni or Benjamini Hochberg) for multiple statistical tests already done within the program or is it done by us once the results are generated?

Thank you,

Remi

messages.subject: Y axis in MaAsLin
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

My question is about knotched box plots using MaAsLin. Can someone explain  what do we get exactly on Y axis? It seems like -as it is written that it is otu arcsin-square root transformed abundance. However, when I try to transform my OTU abundance data using arcsin-square root I got completely different result. Please see in attachment the figure (Left panel is MaAsLin and right panel is the one that transformed).

Additionally, I’d like to ask one more thing. I can see that possible outliers are labelled with stars. If I want to know which sample are those, is there a way to identify them? Do we have any way to identified or do I need to do manually?

Thank you very much for your time and help. I’ll be happy if you can help me out for those question and I’m looking forward to hearing from you.

Best wishes,
Bahti
